about: The classes a person may take at the walls of his level (each hundredth level: 100, 200, 300 ...), as in the manhwa Overgeared and the classes of Reincarnated as a Slime, with names of our own (orders 91 and 92, D-184; src/people/9999975-level/c-classes.core.js). A tree, not a ladder: a class leads to several at the next wall (from), and at each wall a person chooses among the classes his road and skills open (two to four options on a card for the player; A.WHY.decide for anyone else) or takes a stat boost instead. A class ADDS things to do: a technique for duels (tech: an active skill, read as a style's technique), a passive that fires under its condition in a duel (passive), a buff (a stat raised for some months, or blood recovered: an activity), a new way to earn or fight (act: an activity). Every class on a person's road keeps its parts; only the class he holds now gives its effects (the skills adapter's vocabulary, so the caps of skills-v2 §2.4 bind it with his skills and titles). Order 95: classes as in Overgeared, hundreds in the end: the base classes and their advancements here by hand, and the generator below adding advanced and hidden branches on every road; a class's rarity (a word of the one ladder, data/rarity.json, D-200: basic, rare, epic, legendary, mythical; a legendary or mythical class has one living holder and cannot be advanced) never changes along its line (an advancement keeps it), while a hidden branch may be rarer, with stronger effects. A class read at seeding (on load, at the first month, at an NPC's first fight) is worn: its parts, no effects, no honour, no points (his worth, from which his level was read, already holds them).
fieldsNote: A class: id, rarity (the one ladder, data/rarity.json: basic, rare, epic, legendary, mythical; legendary and mythical: one living holder, nothing follows them), line (its advancements keep the line and the rarity), req (hidden conditions: skill [key, min], deed [kind, min], deeds [[kind, min], ...] (each), status [list], rung (a house's rank, at least)), name, step (1 the first class on a road, 2, 3), from (the classes it follows; null: a first class), fam (the skill families whose best level must reach need[step]; 'any' is any art of arms), ways (the ways of life it suits, level.json ways), deeds (deed-ledger kinds that speak for it), title (a title he must hold: the Sword Saint), rank (its weight as a source in the skills adapter), honour (paid once, on taking it), effects (the skills' vocabulary), tech (an active: a duel technique, the release's fields: base strike/feint/guard/press, weapon, uses, cost, fx, desc), passive (on: lowHp, beast, first, mounted, shieldGuard, foeGuard, late; edge, fury, heal; once a duel for fury and heal), act (an activity: key, name, desc, cat, s, s2, d, coin [lo, hi], hurt, deed) and buff (an activity: key, name, desc, stat, v, months, or heal), hook (a few words for the card at the wall), text (what the class is, in the world's words).

boost.about: Points to place, by the wall (the first, the second ...; the last number for every wall after), when the person takes the boost or no class is open to him: through A.LV.grant, recorded on the level (lv.gx, lv.gw).

passiveWords.shieldGuard: when you guard behind a shield
passiveWords.foeGuard: when the foe hides behind his guard

classes.hook: a rising cut, and an eye for the first exchange
classes.name: Swordsman

tech.name: Rising Cut
tech.desc: Up from the low guard, under his blade and into the arm.

classes.text: A man the sword has chosen: a cut of his own in a duel, and an eye that measures a foe in the first exchange.

classes.hook: a long thrust that keeps men off
classes.name: Spearman

tech.name: Long Thrust
tech.desc: All the shaft's length in one step: he is hit before he is near.

classes.text: A spear that keeps men off: a thrust from far out, and a point he cannot hide from behind his guard.

classes.hook: a shot before the clash
classes.name: Archer

tech.name: Aimed Shot
tech.desc: One breath held, one shaft loosed before he closes.

classes.text: The bow as a trade: a shot taken before the clash, and an eye at its sharpest in the first exchange.

classes.hook: a shield that strikes back
classes.name: Shieldbearer

tech.name: Shield Bash
tech.desc: Take the blow on the boss and drive the boss into his face.

classes.text: A wall of one: a shield that strikes back, and a guard that holds when he braces behind it.

classes.hook: a charge with the horse's weight
classes.name: Rider

tech.name: Charge
tech.desc: The horse's weight behind the point, once, at the gallop.

classes.text: A fighter on horseback: a charge that carries the horse's weight, and a seat that steadies every blow.

classes.hook: a stunning headbutt, and a skull that holds
classes.name: Brawler

tech.name: Headbutt
tech.desc: Forehead to the bridge of the nose, and the fight is half over.

classes.text: Fists and a hard head: a blow that stuns, and a body that fights hardest when it is losing.

classes.hook: a sense for beasts, and game to sell
classes.name: Hunter

tech.name: Hamstring Cut
tech.desc: Low and behind the knee, the way you take a stag that will not lie down.

act.name: Hunt for the market
act.desc: A week in the woods for meat and hides to sell. Your woodcraft against the season.

classes.text: The woods as a living: a cut that brings a beast down, a sense for the wild, and game to sell.

classes.hook: one heavy blow, and a second wind
classes.name: Warrior

tech.name: Heavy Blow
tech.desc: Everything you have in one blow, and the wind to pay for it.

classes.text: Any weapon, any fight: one blow with all his weight, and breath that comes back when he is nearly down.

classes.hook: a flowing counter, and pupils who pay
classes.name: Sword Master

tech.name: Flowing Counter
tech.desc: His blade slides off yours and yours goes on into him.

act.name: Teach the sword for pay
act.desc: Young men of good family pay to be shown the guards. Your sword against your patience.

classes.text: The sword as an art to teach: a counter that flows, and pupils who pay to learn it.

classes.hook: a feint that reads him, and fights for a purse
classes.name: Duelist

tech.name: Read and Thrust
tech.desc: Show him an opening and watch what he does with it.

act.name: Fight for a purse
act.desc: A wager on first blood behind an inn. The purse is good; so is the other man.

classes.text: One man against one: a feint that reads him, and fights for a purse wherever men wager.

classes.hook: cutting steps, and a body kept light
classes.name: Blade Dancer

tech.name: Whirling Steps
tech.desc: Turn inside his blow and open him as you go past.

buff.name: Dancer's breath
buff.desc: A month of the old forms at dawn. Your feet are lighter for a season.

classes.text: The sword as a dance: steps that cut as they turn, and a body kept light by the forms.

classes.hook: a thrust through mail, and lads to drill
classes.name: Spear Master

tech.name: Piercing Line
tech.desc: A thrust that goes through mail as if it were wool.

act.name: Drill the young spears
act.desc: A village pays you to make its lads into a line that holds. Your spear and your voice.

classes.text: The spear as a line of men: a thrust through mail, and lads drilled into a wall for pay.

classes.hook: a couched charge that unhorses
classes.name: Lancer

tech.name: Couched Lance
tech.desc: The lance under the arm, the horse at full stretch, and him on the ground.

classes.text: Horse and lance as one weapon: a couched charge that unhorses, and a first pass that decides.

classes.hook: a shot for the gap in the plates
classes.name: Marksman

tech.name: Heart Shot
tech.desc: The shaft that finds the gap between the plates.

buff.name: Steady breath
buff.desc: Long hours at the butts, breathing out on the loose. Your eye is keener for a season.

classes.text: The shot that does not miss: an arrow for the gap in the armour, and an eye kept keen by practice.

classes.hook: fights on bad ground, and roads to watch
classes.name: Ranger

tech.name: Snare Shot
tech.desc: Drive him where the ground is bad and take his legs there.

act.name: Range the wild roads
act.desc: A lord pays for the roads through his woods to be watched. Your eyes against what hides there.

classes.text: The wild roads as a beat: a fight on ground of his choosing, and lords who pay for their roads watched.

classes.hook: wounds bound, and carts to guard
classes.name: Guardian

buff.name: Bind your hurts
buff.desc: A day of rest, clean linen and the old soldier's salve. Blood comes back.

act.name: Guard a merchant's road
act.desc: A trader's carts, a long road and men who would like what is in them. Your shield for his coin.

classes.text: A shield hired out: wounds bound the old soldier's way, and carts kept safe on the roads for pay.

classes.hook: a stand at the gate that outlasts
classes.name: Warden

tech.name: Hold the Gate
tech.desc: Stand in the gap and let him tire himself on you.

classes.text: The one who holds the gate: a stand that gets his breath back, and a guard that grows as the fight runs on.

classes.hook: a clinch that strips a weapon, and the pits
classes.name: Pit Fighter

tech.name: Clinch
tech.desc: Get inside his arms, lean on him and wrench the weapon.

act.name: Fight in the pits
act.desc: Bare fists in a ring of shouting men, and a cut of the wagers. You may come home with less teeth.

classes.text: Fighting as a living: a clinch that strips a weapon, and the pits where men pay to watch.

classes.hook: a bleeding stroke, and bounties on beasts
classes.name: Beastslayer

tech.name: Gutting Stroke
tech.desc: Open the belly and step back while it bleeds out.

act.name: Take a bounty on a beast
act.desc: A village has lost sheep, then a child. They will pay for the thing's head.

classes.text: What preys on men, hunted: a stroke that bleeds a beast, patience against it, and bounties from frightened villages.

classes.hook: a rage when you bleed
classes.name: Berserker

buff.name: Work yourself to a fury
buff.desc: Days of hard labour and harder drink until the anger sits just under the skin. Stronger for a while.

classes.text: Rage as a weapon: a fury that wakes when he bleeds, and strength he can call up for a season.

classes.hook: the cut there is no guard for
classes.name: Sword Saint
classes.title: sword-saint

tech.name: Heaven's Edge
tech.desc: The cut there is no guard for, because it is already through.

classes.text: The strongest art of one man against one foe the world has known. One living holder, and he must bear the Saint's name.

classes.hook: a thousand small cuts, and a hall of your own
classes.name: Blade Master

tech.name: Thousand Cuts
tech.desc: Not one great blow: twenty small ones, each opening him a little more.

act.name: Keep a fencing hall
act.desc: Your own hall, your own pupils, and their fathers' silver. Your name has to fill it.

classes.text: A master of masters: cuts that open a man by inches, and a hall of his own full of paying pupils.

classes.hook: a thrust no scale stops
classes.name: Dragon Spear

tech.name: Dragon Thrust
tech.desc: The thrust they say went through a wyrm's scale and out of its back.

classes.text: A spear fit for a dragon: a thrust no scale or plate stops, and a nerve that hardens as the fight runs on.

classes.hook: two arrows at once
classes.name: Hawkeye

tech.name: Twin Arrows
tech.desc: Two shafts on the string, and both find him.

classes.text: The bow at its height: two arrows at once, and a first shot that is almost never wasted.

classes.hook: blood that comes back when you should fall
classes.name: Bulwark

buff.name: Harden the body
buff.desc: Cold water, heavy stones and the shield held out at arm's length until dark. Tougher for a season.

classes.text: The man who does not fall: blood that comes back when he should be down, and a body hardened like a wall.

classes.hook: a last stand, feasts, and lords who pay for your name
classes.name: Warlord

buff.name: Hold a war feast
buff.desc: Meat, drink and the old stories for every man who fought beside you. They will follow you further for it, and so will your nerve.

act.name: Hire out your sword and your name
act.desc: A lord with a quarrel pays well for a man the soldiers will follow. The work is what you would expect.

classes.text: A man soldiers follow: a last stand that turns a fight, feasts that bind men to him, and lords who pay for his name.

classes.hook: an oath that holds when the fight runs long, and prayers that close wounds
classes.name: Oathsworn

buff.name: Keep a vigil over your wounds
buff.desc: A night on your knees in the chapel, and the priest's hands on the cuts. You rise mended.

act.name: Ride a vow for a lord
act.desc: A lord's oath to keep in his name: a wrong to right, far off. He pays the one who comes back.

classes.text: More than a knight: a sworn man whose oath holds when other men break, who prays his wounds shut, and rides a lord's vows.

classes.hook: a charge that breaks the line, and riders who follow
classes.name: Banner Rider

tech.name: Banner Charge
tech.desc: The banner goes forward and you go with it, through him.

act.name: Lead a lord's riders on a raid
act.desc: A lord lends you his riders and his quarrel. Bring them back with the cattle, and most of them alive.

classes.text: More than a knight: the man the riders follow, with a charge that breaks a line and raids led in a lord's name.

classes.hook: a hunter of monsters, for monstrous bounties
classes.name: Wild Hunter

tech.name: Killing Snare
tech.desc: Lead it where the trap was laid three days ago.

act.name: Hunt what others will not
act.desc: Things in the high woods that eat bears. Lords pay a fortune for their heads, and bury the men who fail.

classes.text: The hunter of monsters: a snare laid days ahead, an old enmity with every beast, and bounties no one else will take.

generator.about: Advanced and hidden branches made on every road at load (c-classes.core.js CL.generate), each a class like the hand-made ones: an id, a name from the template's prefix and the road's noun, a rarity its line keeps (its gifts by rarityStat, rarityFight and rarityHonour, unless the template gives fight or honour of its own), hidden conditions, and parts of its own (a technique named for the road, and the template's passive, buff or work). A template with roads is made on those roads only (by the road's fam). step 2 templates follow the road's base class and have an advancement at step 3 (the same line and rarity: '<name> Master', with a further part); step 3 templates follow any step-2 class off the road's base.

tech.desc: Fast as weather, and as hard to see coming.

tech.name: Storm Break
tech.desc: Everything at once, like a squall off the sea.

templates.hook: speed like weather, and a first exchange that is yours
templates.text: A {noun} as quick as a squall: an opening move that wins the first exchange.

buff.name: Temper the body
buff.desc: Cold water, heavy work and old scars stretched each morning. Tougher for a season.

tech.name: Iron Answer
tech.desc: Take it on the scar and give it back.

templates.hook: blood that comes back, and a body tempered like iron
templates.text: A {noun} hardened by wounds: blood that returns when he is near the end, and a body he tempers.

tech.desc: From where he was not looking.

act.name: Take a quiet contract
act.desc: A purse, a name, and no questions. The work is quiet, and so are the men who fail at it.

tech.name: Unseen Strike
tech.desc: He never sees the blow that ends it.

templates.hook: a blow from where he is not looking, and quiet contracts
templates.text: A {noun} of the dark: a feint from nowhere, and work done for a purse and no questions.

tech.desc: Low and tearing, the way the pack takes a deer.

act.name: Clear a wolf-run for a village
act.desc: Sheep gone, a shepherd's boy gone. The headman pays for a quiet hillside.

templates.hook: a tearing blow, and a sense for beasts
templates.text: A {noun} who hunts like the pack: a tearing blow and an old sense for what prowls.

buff.name: Pray over your wounds
buff.desc: A night on your knees and the old words over every cut. You rise mended.

tech.name: Judgement
tech.desc: Struck in the name of what he believes, and it lands like it.

templates.hook: prayers that close wounds, and a faith that holds
templates.text: A {noun} of the faith: wounds closed by prayer, and a nerve that holds when the fight runs long.

tech.desc: Paid for in his own blood, and worth it.

buff.name: Feed the rage
buff.desc: Old grudges kept warm, and the body driven until the anger answers. Stronger for a while.

templates.hook: a blow paid for in blood, and a fury when you bleed
templates.text: A {noun} who fights best bleeding: a costly blow, and a fury that wakes with the wound.

tech.desc: Taught by masters a king pays for, and it shows.

act.name: Teach the young of a great house
act.desc: A duke's sons, a royal ward. They pay in silver and in favour; they are not easy pupils.

templates.hook: a royal master's guard, and great houses' sons to teach
templates.text: A {noun} of a great house: arts no common master teaches, and the young of the great to teach in turn.

templates.roadsNote: Legendary classes are very few and nearly impossible (order 97, D-201): three, on the arms the songs say have killed dragons, each one living man's at a time, never advanced; a true dragon slain, and five beasts stronger than him.

tech.desc: The blow they say went through dragon scale.

templates.hook: a blow through scale, and a bane to every beast
templates.text: A {noun} who has killed what should have killed him, many times: a blow through scale, and every beast his old enemy.
